recommendation_summary: For now, sort the existing shared order list by pickup date, soonest first, and prepare cakes from the top until today's are done. The reply adds no optional extras. Whether to keep or release the booked Odoo partner is left to the user. No need is left unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want every cake due today prepared before pickup. You also asked for Odoo sales, inventory, and manufacturing synced to the counter, with a partner booked next week, so no pickup is missed.
labels.Deleted: The Odoo rollout. Payments and stock already reconcile, and everyone preparing cakes can already read the one shared list at the counter.
labels.Bottleneck: Preparation order. Cakes for next month were made while cakes due today were still unmade.
labels.Checked myself: Your account of this morning: due-today cakes unmade, next-month orders already prepared, payments and stock reconciled, list readable at the counter.

note: The reply rejects the Odoo rollout by name and recommends only a pickup-date sort of the existing list, with all four record lines grounded in the supplied facts.
